data.name: Fudhailah
data.gender_notes: Fudhailah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Fudhailah is an Arabic name for girls and boys, which means 'a little saved one'. It is derived from the root 'f-d-l' which means 'to save, to rescue'. The name Fudhailah carries the meaning “A little saved one” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Fudhailah usually hope their child will grow to embody a little saved one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Fudhailah represents the hope and faith that every individual has in being saved from difficulty and adversity.
data.etymology: Fudhailah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “A little saved one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fudhailah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: فضيلة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يعني الرفعة و العلو في الخُلُق و الحال
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي و يعني الرفعة و العلو في الخُلُق و الحال، و يدل على المكانة الرفيعة و الشرف العظيم. و قد ورد في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'وَمَن يُعَظِّمْ شَعَائِرَ اللَّهِ فَإِنَّهَا مِنَ الْقُلُوبِ' (الحج: 32)، و هذا يدل على اهمية تعظيم الشعائر و القيم الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: فضیلہ
in_urdu.meaning: رفعت و عظمت والی، اچھے اخلاق و حالات کی مالک
in_urdu.long_meaning: یہ ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے رفعت و عظمت والی، اچھے اخلاق و حالات کی مالک۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں اہم سمجھا جاتا ہے کیونکہ یہ خلق و خوی کی خوبصورتی اور اچھائی کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے۔ فضیلہ نام کے حاملین کو اپنے اچھے اخلاق و کردار کی وجہ سے پہچانا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: फ़ुज़ैला
in_hindi.meaning: उच्च नैतिकता और अच्छे चरित्र की स्वामिनी
in_hindi.long_meaning: यह नाम अरबी मूल का है और इसका अर्थ है उच्च नैतिकता और अच्छे चरित्र की स्वामिनी। इस्लामी परंपरा में इस नाम को बहुत महत्व दिया जाता है क्योंकि यह अच्छे गुणों और उच्च नैतिकता की ओर संकेत करता है। फ़ुज़ैला नाम की लड़कियों को उनके अच्छे चरित्र और उच्च आदर्शों के लिए जाना जाता है।

in_pashto.name: فضيله
in_pashto.meaning: د لوړ اخلاقو او حالتونو مالکې
in_pashto.long_meaning: دا د عربي اصل يو نوم دى چې د لوړ اخلاقو او حالتونو مالکې معنی لري. په اسلامي کلتور کې دا نوم د پام وړ دی ځکه چې دا د ښو اخلاقو او لوړو موخو په لور اشارې کوي. فضيله نومېدونکې نجونې د هغو د ښو اخلاقو او مثالي کردار له امله پېژندل کیږي.

in_english.name: Fudhailah
in_english.meaning: One who possesses high moral character and nobility
in_english.long_meaning: Fudhailah is a feminine Arabic name that signifies one who possesses high moral character and nobility. Etymologically derived from the Arabic root 'f-d-l' which connotes the idea of exceeding or surpassing in goodness and virtue. This name holds spiritual significance in Islamic tradition as it reflects the values of righteousness, compassion, and moral excellence. Historically, the name has been used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing the aspiration for elevated character and piety.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Fudhailah ibn Yasar (d. 803 CE) was a prominent Tabi'i scholar and poet from Kufa, Iraq. The name Fudhailah carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Fudhailah was a scholar and poet during the Tabi'i period, which followed the Prophet Muhammad's death and lasted until the end of the first century AH (7th-8th centuries CE).
